title: Let the Cereal Bowl Mark the Finish
caption:
Breakfast doesn't need to be faster. It needs an ending.

Pick one thing that marks the finish, like the bowl going in the sink.
When the bowl moves, the next step starts.
No countdown, no "are you done yet?" Just a signal we all know.

Save this for the slow-breakfast mornings.

#schoolmornings #morningroutine #elementarymom #parentingtips #steadydays
